description: This charming apartment is ideally located in the heart of Saint-Germain-des-Prés, between Rue de Buci and Rue de Seine, just steps away from the Mabillon, Saint-Germain-des-Prés, and Odéon metro stations. Enjoy a stay in the heart of the Saint-Germain district, in a historic and lively setting, surrounded by the best shops, designer boutiques, art galleries, and iconic restaurants in Paris.It is the perfect place to relax after exploring the treasures of the capital.The spaceThis apartment is a true gem, designed to offer both comfort and style. The beautiful living area is carefully decorated, featuring exposed stone that adds a warm and cozy touch. The bright white walls amplify the natural light, creating a welcoming atmosphere perfect for relaxation.The apartment includes four bedrooms, two of which have independent en-suite bathrooms, ideal for ensuring everyone's privacy. A third full bathroom and a separate toilet with a sink provide optimal comfort for all. The fully equipped kitchen makes meal preparation effortless, while the inviting dining area is perfect for sharing delicious moments and creating unforgettable memories.It is the perfect place for a family vacation or a getaway with friends, right in the heart of Paris, in an authentic and welcoming setting.Guest accessYou will have access to the entire apartment, which you can reach easily via public transportation.The nearest metro stations are:Mabillon (Line 10): right in front of the apartmentSaint-Germain-des-Prés (Line 4): 300 meters from the apartment on footOdéon (Line 4): 300 meters from the apartment on footThese stations will allow you to get around Paris quickly, and the RER at Châtelet-Les Halles provides direct connections to the airports.Other things to noteHouse RulesWe strive to maintain a
